_comment: Download sources for setup/Setup-Extras.ps1. Each url, size and sha256 was read from the Hugging Face file list on 2026-11-06 (companion files, the two Qwen LoRAs, the upscalers, the SkinToken VAE, the face models and Anima on 2026-11-13, the two Z-Image files on 2026-11-14). 'publisher' is true when the repository belongs to the model's own publisher (or ComfyUI's Comfy-Org for ComfyUI-format files); false means a community upload. Edit a link here when it changes; no code change needed. Your own additions go in setup/downloads.local.json (same shape).

zturbo.name: Z-Image Turbo (the first picture)
zturbo.note: Z-Image Turbo by Tongyi-MAI (Apache-2.0), as ComfyUI's own Comfy-Org organisation packages it for ComfyUI: int8 (convrot), 6.2 GB. Tongyi-MAI's own repository holds only the diffusers layout, which ComfyUI does not load directly. It is loaded with the Qwen 3 4B text encoder and the ae VAE from the same Comfy-Org repository.

zbase.name: Z-Image base
zbase.note: Z-Image (base) by Tongyi-MAI (Apache-2.0), as Comfy-Org packages it for ComfyUI: int8 (convrot), 6.2 GB. Saved as z_image_base_int8_convrot.safetensors, not the publisher's name (z_image_int8_convrot.safetensors), so it never meets the earlier community file of that name, which differs.

hy3d_mv.name: Hunyuan3D-2mv (second 3D route)
hy3d_mv.note: Saved under the name the app expects (Hunyuan3D-2mv.fp16.safetensors); the publisher's file is hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mv/model.fp16.safetensors.

skintoken.name: SkinToken (rigging)
skintoken.note: The ComfyUI-SkinToken node pack also fetches this file itself on first use, into models/skintoken.

trellis2_dino.name: DINOv3 image encoder (TRELLIS.2 companion)
trellis2_dino.licence: DINOv3 License (Meta), see the note in models.yaml
trellis2_dino.note: The TRELLIS.2 graph loads dino_v3_vit_l.safetensors (backend/vgac/graphs/trellis.py). It is listed in models.yaml (companions), so the app's own check looks for it.

gemma3_12b.name: Gemma 3 12B (local picture judge)
gemma3_12b.licence: Google Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy
gemma3_12b.note: Optional. A ComfyUI-format copy of Google's Gemma 3 12B hosted by Comfy-Org. The terms are Google's; you accept them yourself.

qwen_te.name: Qwen 2.5 VL 7B text encoder (Qwen edit companion)
qwen_te.note: Loaded by the side-view and picture-edit graph (backend/vgac/graphs/qwen_edit.py) next to qwen_edit.

qwen_vae.name: Qwen image VAE (Qwen edit and Anima companion)
qwen_vae.note: Loaded by the side-view graph and by the Anima concept graph.

zimage_te.name: Qwen 3 4B text encoder (Z-Image Base and FLUX.2 Klein companion)
zimage_te.note: One file for both: the Z-Image Base graph and the FLUX.2 Klein graph load it by this name. The Comfy-Org/flux2-klein-4b repository holds the same file (same SHA-256).

pose_control.name: Z-Image Turbo pose control (Fun ControlNet Union 2.1)
pose_control.note: Alibaba PAI's own repository (Apache-2.0 on its card). Makes the first picture of a character follow a fixed A-pose skeleton. Size and SHA-256 are the publisher's own (Hugging Face X-Linked-Size and X-Linked-ETag, read 2026-11-25) and match the file already installed.

flux_ae.name: FLUX autoencoder ae (Z-Image Base and Chroma companion)
flux_ae.note: One file for both: the Z-Image Base graph and the Chroma graph load it by this name. Licence as stated on the Comfy-Org page.

flux2_vae.name: FLUX.2 VAE (FLUX.2 Klein companion)
flux2_vae.note: Taken from the Klein repository. The Comfy-Org/flux2-dev repository holds a different build of the same name (336213556 bytes, FLUX.1-dev non-commercial licence); do not use that one.

chroma_te.name: T5-XXL fp8 scaled text encoder (Chroma companion)

anima_te.name: Qwen 3 0.6B base text encoder (Anima companion)
anima_te.licence: Anima licence (non-commercial model, outputs usable commercially)

skintoken_vae.name: SkinToken skin VAE (rigging companion)
skintoken_vae.note: The ComfyUI-SkinToken node pack loads this next to grpo_1400.ckpt and fetches it itself on first use. It also fetches the small Qwen3-0.6B tokenizer and config files (no weights) from Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B into models/skintoken/Qwen3-0.6B.

face_model.name: MediaPipe face landmarker (ComfyUI route of the eye and mouth finder)
face_model.note: Optional. backend/vgac/facemarks.py asks a ComfyUI card for this file first and falls back to the mediapipe Python package (runtime/models/face_landmarker.task) and then to a darkest-spot finder. Not on the owner's disk.

upscale_photo.name: 4xRealWebPhoto v4 (DAT2) upscaler
upscale_photo.note: Saved under the name the app expects (4xRealWebPhoto_v4_dat2.pth); the publisher's file is 4xRealWebPhoto_v4.pth in the Phips/4xRealWebPhoto_v4_dat2 repository (same bytes as the file the app was built with).

upscale_art.name: Real-ESRGAN x2plus upscaler
upscale_art.note: Size from the GitHub release asset; GitHub gives no checksum for it, so the SHA-256 is that of the owner's copy, which is the file the app was built with.

upscale_wood.name: 4x-PBRify UpscalerV4 (wood upscaler)
upscale_wood.note: Needed only for the wood material upscaler (backend/vgac/graphs/material.py); without it wood is drawn at the texture size, exactly as before. Licence proof: the release page at the page link says License: CC0, and OpenModelDB lists CC0-1.0 with commercial use allowed (bakeoff/wp58/models/pbrify_v4/LICENCE-NOTE.md). The host repository reports NOASSERTION and has no LICENSE file, so the release notes and OpenModelDB are the proof. Size and SHA-256 are those of the file the app was tested with, checked against the release download on 2026-11-21.

anima.name: Anima Turbo v1.1
anima.note: Found in the publisher's repository under split_files/diffusion_models (an earlier note here said it was missing; that was wrong). Non-commercial model; what it makes may be used commercially. Needs the Anima companions anima_te and qwen_vae.

turnaround_sheet.name: Qwen character turnaround sheet add-on
turnaround_sheet.note: Saved under the name the app expects; the publisher's file is character_turnaround_sheet_v3_qwen_image_edit_2511_000000400.safetensors. Apache-2.0.

turnaround_white.name: Qwen camera-angle add-on
turnaround_white.note: Saved under the name the app expects; the publisher's file is qwen_edit_2511_camera_angle_lora.safetensors. Apache-2.0.

face_landmarker.name: MediaPipe face landmarker (eyes and mouth)
face_landmarker.note: Lives in the project's runtime/models folder, not in ComfyUI. Used by backend/vgac/lipmarks.py through the mediapipe Python package; without it the mouth is placed by the older finder. Size and MD5 are Google's (HTTP headers on 2026-11-13); the SHA-256 is that of the owner's copy, whose MD5 matches Google's.

pose_landmarker.name: MediaPipe pose landmarker, heavy (arms and legs for the pose check)
pose_landmarker.note: Lives in the project's runtime/models folder. Used by backend/vgac/buildpose.py through the mediapipe Python package: the pose check before the 3D build reads the arms' angle from it and the pose redraw's guard places the body parts with it. Without it the arms are read from the outline and the guard does not compare garments, which the check says. Size and MD5 are Google's (HTTP headers on 2026-11-13) and match the downloaded copy; the SHA-256 is that copy's.

hand_landmarker.name: MediaPipe hand landmarker (open hands or fists for the pose check)
hand_landmarker.note: Lives in the project's runtime/models folder. Used by backend/vgac/buildpose.py through the mediapipe Python package: open hand, fist or not found. Without it the hands are not checked, which the check says. The same file ships inside the comfyui_controlnet_aux node pack (mesh_graphormer folder). Size and MD5 are Google's (HTTP headers on 2026-11-13) and match the downloaded copy; the SHA-256 is that copy's.

skintoken.name: ComfyUI-SkinToken
skintoken.licence: No licence file in the pack; it defers to the MIT SkinTokens project (not confirmed as its own licence)

vgac.name: vgac-nodes (this project)
vgac.what: The project's own mesh loader nodes.

comfyui_install._comment: VGAC's own ComfyUI (backend/vgac/comfy_install.py). The source is the zip of one commit; GitHub keeps the files inside such a zip the same but not its bytes (its compression may change after six months' notice), so the zip's SHA-256 is checked first and, if it differs, every unpacked file is checked against tree_list (path, size, SHA-256), whose own SHA-256 is pinned here. While sha256 or tree_sha256 is empty, the app refuses to install. The Python packages are in lock (one wheel each, SHA-256 pinned).
comfyui_install.pinned: Read on 2026-11-15 from one download of the zip (13,719,368 bytes), after checking that tag v0.45.3 points at this commit and that all 1,346 files match the commit's git tree on GitHub. Nothing in the zip was run.
comfyui_install.installed_note: The Python environment of a working ComfyUI 0.45.3 with SkinToken (with a few more packages than this lock) measured 4.68 GB on 2026-11-15.

blender.sha256_source: Read once from download.blender.org/release/Blender5.2/blender-5.2.3.sha256 on 2026-11-14. The downloaded file is accepted only if it matches this pin.

ual1.name: Universal Animation Library (Standard)
ual1.what: The ready-made moves (walk, run, idle and more) for rigged humanoid characters.
ual1.author: Quaternius

ual2.name: Universal Animation Library 2 (Standard)
ual2.what: More ready-made moves; Unreal-style bone names, which the app maps itself.
ual2.author: Quaternius

mesh2motion.name: Mesh2Motion animal clips
mesh2motion.what: Ready-made walk, run, attack and other moves for four-legged creatures.
mesh2motion.author: Mesh2Motion
mesh2motion.licence_note: The repository README says: The art assets (3d models, rigs, animations) are all licensed under CC0. Read 2026-11-24.

animation_note: Both packs are on itch.io (linked from quaternius.com). itch.io hands the file over after a click-through, so the helper does not fetch it: you download the zip, and the helper unpacks it into data/animations/<id>, keeping the folder names backend/config.yaml expects.
